title: Materials: wood, metal, plastic, glass
examples: Teacher, what is a window usually made of?
Can you show us something that is bendy?
Which material is hard like a rock?

explain.say: Today we learn about different materials around us. We will explore what they are made of.
First we look at properties. Properties are the special ways things are.
Wood is often hard and can be bendy when young. Think about a wooden ruler you use.
Metal like iron is very hard and strong. A metal spoon is a good example of this.
Plastic can be soft or hard, and sometimes it is see-through. A plastic cup is a simple example.
Glass is very hard and usually see-through. A window pane is a perfect example for us.

faq.q: What is the difference between hard and strong?
faq.a: Hard means it resists being scratched or pressed. Strong means it can hold weight without breaking. For example, metal is both very hard and very strong.
asks: Are hard and strong the same thing?
Does a strong material have to be hard?

faq.a: No, some materials block light completely. Wood and metal are usually not see-through because they are solid.
asks: Are there any materials that are not see-through?

faq.a: No, plastic comes in many types. Some plastic toys are very hard, while others are soft like balloons.

faq.q: Why is glass so popular for windows?
faq.a: Glass is hard, which keeps things safe from wind. It is also see-through, which lets us see outside.
asks: What is the best material for a window?
Why do we use glass in buildings?

faq.q: If something is bendy, does it mean it is soft?
faq.a: Not always. A thick, bendy piece of wood is not necessarily soft. Softness relates more to how easily it squishes.
asks: Is bendy the same as flexible?
Can something be bendy but still hard?

facts: Wood comes from trees and can be carved into many shapes.
Metal is usually shiny and is good at holding its shape.
Glass is made by heating sand until it is liquid.
A material can have more than one property, like being hard and see-through.

quiz.say: Which material is typically hard, bendy, and comes from trees?
quiz.why: Wood is known for being hard enough to build with, but it can also bend a little bit.

wrong.0: Glass is hard, but it is not usually described as bendy.
wrong.2: Metal is usually too hard to bend easily.
wrong.3: Plastic can be soft, not always fitting the description.

quiz.say: If you need something that lets lots of light through, which material is best?
quiz.why: Glass is specifically known for letting light pass through it so we can see.

wrong.0: While some plastic is see-through, glass is the classic example.
wrong.2: Wood blocks most of the light from passing through it.
wrong.3: Metal is solid and does not let light pass through easily.

quiz.say: A soft material that can be squished easily is most like:
quiz.why: Plastic can be made into soft items, which is a key property we learned today.

wrong.1: Metal is usually too hard to be easily squished.
wrong.2: Wood is generally too rigid to be described as soft.
wrong.3: Glass is very hard and does not squish easily.
